svg.title: New York dispatch example: 100 courier routes and 16,030 mapped visits
svg.desc: Midtown Manhattan sample. 15,876 assigned visits and 154 held visits. Marks group visits at the same coordinates; greater marks show more visits. Route paths sharing the same geography may overlap. Street geometry © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Not live navigation.
